classification_legend.VALIDATED: Claim survived rigorous testing (forensic re-computation, reproducibility, human or deterministic validation). Still authoritative.
classification_legend.INVALIDATED: Claim was tested and refuted by later evidence. NOT authoritative.
classification_legend.RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY: Claim describes what the system reconstructed from known data, not a genuine discovery. Authoritative as a reconstruction claim, NOT as a discovery claim.
classification_legend.UNTESTED: Claim was made but never rigorously tested against a held-out or adversarial standard. NOT authoritative.
classification_legend.PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW: Claim awaits independent human adjudication. Provisionally authoritative pending human review.
